description: This file contains cryptographic functions related to elliptic curve operations on the P-256 curve, including point multiplication, addition, inversion, and comparison, optimized for specific architectures. It includes external dependencies on OpenSSL headers and internal project headers, and defines several static functions and method implementations for elliptic curve operations.

methods.name: booth_recode_w5
methods.description: Recode window to a signed digit for 5-bit window.

methods.name: booth_recode_w7
methods.description: Recode window to a signed digit for 7-bit window.

methods.name: copy_conditional
methods.description: Conditionally copy source to destination based on move mask.

methods.name: is_not_zero
methods.description: Check if input is non-zero, return 1 if true, 0 if false.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_mod_inverse_sqr_mont
methods.description: Compute modular inverse square in Montgomery domain.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_windowed_mul
methods.description: Perform windowed scalar multiplication of a point.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_point_mul
methods.description: Multiply a point by a scalar.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_point_mul_base
methods.description: Multiply the generator point by a scalar.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_points_mul_public
methods.description: Compute a public point from scalar and base point.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_get_affine
methods.description: Get affine coordinates from Jacobian point.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_inv0_mod_ord
methods.description: Compute inverse modulo group order using addition chains.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_scalar_to_montgomery_inv_vartime
methods.description: Convert scalar to Montgomery form with inversion, optimized for x86_64 with AVX.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_cmp_x_coordinate
methods.description: Compare the x-coordinate of a point with a scalar.
